description: Post a message to a channel, a private channel or a direct message

token.label: Slack bot token
token.description: The xoxb- token of your Slack app, installed in the workspace

channel.label: Channel id
channel.description: The channel to post in, e.g. C0123456789. Use List channels to find one.

text.label: Message
text.description: The text to post. Slack's mrkdwn is understood.

thread_ts.label: Reply to
thread_ts.description: The ts of a message to reply to, leaving this one in its thread

ts.description: The message's timestamp, which is its id in every other method

channel.description: The channel it was posted in

permalink.description: A link to the message, when Slack returns one
